name: shadow-compact
description: Verified-checkpoint compaction for Claude Code: a private builder and independent verifier prepare an evidence-grounded checkpoint in the background, and Claude Code's own /compact or auto-compaction installs it through session.compact with the exact recent tail preserved by handle.

prepareThresholdTokens.title: Checkpoint threshold (tokens)
prepareThresholdTokens.description: Absolute context token count at which background checkpoint preparation starts. Must be a positive integer below the auto-compact window so the checkpoint is ready before Claude Code compacts.

configureAutoCompactWindow.title: Set Claude's auto-compact window
configureAutoCompactWindow.description: On a model's first session, set Claude Code's auto-compact window (as /autocompact does, saved per model) unless a window is already chosen in settings or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW.

autoCompactWindowTokens.title: Auto-compact window (tokens)
autoCompactWindowTokens.description: Window Shadow sets for Claude Code auto-compaction. The engine compacts somewhat below it (~175k for 190k); keep it above the checkpoint threshold.

configureIdleCompaction.title: Lower Claude's idle-compaction floor
configureIdleCompaction.description: Set CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS for the session (unless already set, or idleCompaction is false) and prepare a checkpoint when a turn completes above it, so Claude Code's idle compaction installs Shadow's checkpoint.

idleCompactMinTokens.title: Idle-compaction floor (tokens)
idleCompactMinTokens.description: Minimum context for Claude Code's idle compaction, which fires shortly before the one-hour prompt cache expires. Claude Code's default is 200000 and it refuses less than 100000.

recentTurns.title: Recent turns kept verbatim
recentTurns.description: Minimum number of recent user-anchored turns preserved exactly (by engine handle) after the checkpoint.

builderModel.title: Builder model
builderModel.description: Model alias or id for the private checkpoint-builder agent; haiku keeps cost low, inherit uses the session model.

verifierModel.title: Verifier model
verifierModel.description: Model alias or id for the private checkpoint-verifier agent; haiku keeps cost low, inherit uses the session model.

builderBackend.title: Builder backend
builderBackend.description: claude runs the builder as a private Claude agent (default). pi runs it through Shadow's bundled Pi SDK worker with the provider and model below; this sends the sanitized evidence archive to that external provider. If a Pi preparation fails, Shadow redoes it with the Claude models.

verifierBackend.title: Verifier backend
verifierBackend.description: claude runs the verifier as a private Claude agent (default). pi runs it through Shadow's bundled Pi SDK worker with the provider and model below; this sends the sanitized evidence archive to that external provider. If a Pi preparation fails, Shadow redoes it with the Claude models.

piBuilderProvider.title: Pi builder provider
piBuilderProvider.description: Pi provider id for the builder when its backend is pi (e.g. openrouter, openai, anthropic). Credentials come from Pi itself: run pi and /login.

piBuilderModel.title: Pi builder model
piBuilderModel.description: Model id in Pi's catalog for the builder when its backend is pi.

piVerifierProvider.title: Pi verifier provider
piVerifierProvider.description: Pi provider id for the verifier when its backend is pi (e.g. openrouter, openai, anthropic). Credentials come from Pi itself: run pi and /login.

piVerifierModel.title: Pi verifier model
piVerifierModel.description: Model id in Pi's catalog for the verifier when its backend is pi.

piNodePath.title: Node for the Pi worker
piNodePath.description: Node.js (20+) executable that runs the Pi worker; used only when a backend is pi.

manualCompactMode.title: Manual /compact mode
manualCompactMode.description: shadow answers /compact with the verified checkpoint when one covers the transcript; native always defers to Claude Code compaction.
